plan.scope: per-worker true-loopback experiment; no timing improvement is an acceptance precondition

run_status.scope: execution/integrity only; summarizer independently validates every planned arm

scopes.latency: capacity: actual-request-to-completion at fixed concurrency; rate15000: scheduled-to-completion, with service and dispatch lateness separate; never add quantiles
scopes.aggregation: six arm medians per fixture/name; p99 is a median of arm percentiles, not a pooled request percentile; all planned arms must seal before aggregation
scopes.offered_load: rate15000 uses bounded admission at128, not unrestricted open loop; per-arm cap/wait counts retained
scopes.process_cpu: server/helper user+system over entire client span, including handshake/warmup/measurement/output/drain, divided by measured+warmup responses; kernel/IRQ work charged elsewhere excluded
scopes.pmu: server/helper user-mode instructions/cycles only; kernel/IRQ/hypervisor work excluded; whole-span response denominator
scopes.whole_vm: all Linux VM CPUs user+nice+system+IRQ+softIRQ, retained as ticks/R and converted with recorded tick timebase; clients and unrelated Linux work included; Windows-host CPU/scheduling unobserved; kernel BPF may run in client/IRQ contexts outside server-owned process CPU
scopes.goal: validity does not depend on favorable performance; primary rate CPU comparisons are fresh kernel versus both native PGO controls; capacity release p99 closes original regression only if observed lower for both fixtures; goal achievement is a separate assessment
